biggest_catch: REJECT — JustPlay GmbH is a real Berlin company with a live, actively updated app, but the company publishes no concrete payout terms: no minimum redemption, no coin-to-dollar conversion. Its own rules page states the conversion rate differs per user and is driven by ad-auction bids and fraud scoring — unpublished by design.
catches: The company's own Play Store listing (official source) promises 'cash out every 3 hours' via PayPal or gift cards and 'no subscriptions, no paywalls' — but states no minimum amount and no coin conversion rate.

Third-party analysis of the official loyalty-program rules page: the coin-to-money conversion rate is not fixed; it differs per user based on ad-auction bids, proprietary fraud scoring, achievements, time spent, and country — so users cannot calculate what coins are worth.

JustPlay's own Play Store disclaimer: 'any amounts of earnings, rewards, coins and/or prizes shown in our advertisements and/or marketing materials... are for illustration purposes only and may not reflect the actual earnings.'
The app is Android-focused (Google Play listing live, updated August 2026, 10M+ downloads, 4.4 stars, 1.5M+ reviews) — iOS availability unconfirmed in official sources obtained.
Same checklist bar as the Mistplay rejection (R0161): legit company, no concrete payout in official terms — stays unverified; rejection logged rather than forcing a positive.

c1.evidence: JustPlay GmbH, Berlin, Germany — real operating company; Google Play listing for 'JustPlay: Earn Money or Donate' live with 10M+ downloads, updated August 2026; hiring pages corroborate the company.

c2.evidence: FAIL — no concrete payout terms published by the company itself: official listing describes loyalty coins for playtime with PayPal/gift-card redemption every 3 hours but states no minimum, no coin-to-dollar conversion; the company's own rules say the rate varies per user and is not published.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee — official listing: 'No subscriptions. No paywalls. Just free to play games and rewards.'

c4.evidence: FAIL — official sources obtained (company's own Play Store listing, crawled live) carry mechanics only; no official source with concrete payout figures was obtainable.

eligibility: Free app on Android; age 17+ per Play Store listing; regional availability varies (US/AU/GB listings exist).
notes: Legitimacy rejection is NOT what this is — JustPlay is a real, actively maintained rewards app. It fails the concrete-terms bar because the company deliberately does not publish a payout schedule. If JustPlay publishes a redemption table officially, re-check. Note: the android app_links URL was returned verbatim in the search results of this session.
